title: Correctness of OR normalization
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $c$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ variables, and let $x$ assign a Boolean value to each of those variables. The OR-normal form of $c$ evaluates under $x$ to the same value as $c$.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a Boolean circuit on $n$ variables
$x$ is an assignment of Boolean values to the $n$ variables
replaced:
Let $c$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ variables and let $x : \mathrm{Fin}\,n \to \bbf_2$
be an assignment. Then the normal-form OR circuit obtained by OR-normalizing $c$
computes the same Boolean value as $c$ itself: evaluated at $x$, it agrees with the
value of $c$ at $x$.
